name: Fish Welfare Initiative: dissolved oxygen on fish farms (Ambitious Impact, 2019 summary)
summary: Charity Entrepreneurship's January 2019 estimate for managing dissolved oxygen on fish farms by subsidising aeration, the idea Fish Welfare Initiative was founded in 2019 to work on. FWI later dropped aeration because it led farmers to stock fish more densely (Vasco Grilo, EA Forum 2024), so this scores the founding idea, not FWI's programme today. The summary's $0.0009 to $0.013 per welfare point counts equipment and running costs only, not the charity's overhead, how many farmers take it up, or the density backfire, so it is an upper bound; we add a rough factor for uptake and delivery. Welfare points are AIM's pre-2024 unit; our bridge turns them into days of pain and weighs fish like every other animal model.

source.title: Improving Environmental Conditions - A Summary (K. Sarek, J. Savoie, D. Moss)
source.license: AIM terms of use: non-commercial use and citation with attribution; no open licence found

sections.title: Charity Entrepreneurship's estimate (summary report)
sections.explainer: A 6-page summary of a 25-page unpublished report. Ambitious Impact has said it does not want to publish the old sheet (Vasco Grilo, EA Forum, 2024). FWI dropped aeration after finding it led farmers to stock more densely, so this is the founding idea's ex ante estimate.

sections.title: Staff pay below market
sections.explainer: charityevals' step, not Ambitious Impact's: with credit by share of resources on, staff's forgone pay counts as part of the cost.

sections.title: From welfare points to days of pain (ours)
sections.explainer: charityevals' bridge, not Ambitious Impact's. Ambitious Impact stops at welfare points per dollar, a unit it retired in 2024 and that has no published exchange rate to anything else. We turn welfare points back into days of disabling pain on the animal's own scale, with one shared rate (facts: aim_wp.pain_days_per_wp_year) used by every welfare-point model, so the species weights below can be applied like in every other animal model.

sections.title: In chicken pain days
sections.explainer: charityevals' standard species step: days of pain of fish, weighed by how much they can suffer relative to a chicken (Rethink Priorities' welfare ranges, which already include the chance an animal is sentient).

rows.label: Cost per welfare point

source.title: Improving Environmental Conditions - A Summary (K. Sarek, J. Savoie, D. Moss)
source.quote: very cost-effective, ranging from $0.0009 to $0.013 per welfare point (the price for substitution is contingent on the aeration equipment)

rows.explainer: Charity Entrepreneurship gives only a range: the cost depends on whether the charity has to buy aeration equipment ("Some farmers may already be equipped and the additional costs are thus only operational"). The best guess is ours: the dear end, where the charity pays for the equipment, since subsidising aeration is the approach the summary costs. The cheap end is the low end of the range. Either way it leaves out the charity's own overhead, farmers' uptake and the risk that better oxygen lets farmers stock more densely, so it is an upper bound.

rows.label: Welfare points gained per fish per year (for reference)

source.title: Improving Environmental Conditions - A Summary (K. Sarek, J. Savoie, D. Moss)
source.quote: We estimate that the intervention wins fish 14.75 welfare points per year

rows.explainer: Page 2 gives 21.5 (fish from −43 to −21.5), page 3 14.75; Charity Entrepreneurship doesn't say which its cost per point uses. Vasco Grilo (EA Forum, 2024) reads 14.75 per fish-year. For reference only.

rows.label: Welfare points per dollar (Ambitious Impact's bottom line)
rows.explainer: The reciprocal of the cost per welfare point. Welfare points are Charity Entrepreneurship's pre-2024 unit: a fish's welfare scored from −100 to +100, for a year.

rows.label: Staff pay as a share of program cost
rows.explainer: Default for programs that mostly buy and hand out goods (nets, drugs, supplements, vaccines, water treatment): staff pay is a small part of the cost. Our judgment; we haven't seen this program's breakdown.

rows.label: Pay gap versus comparable jobs elsewhere
rows.explainer: Delivery staff are mostly hired locally at local rates, so the gap is small. Our judgment.

rows.label: Salary forgone by staff per dollar of cost (in-kind donation)
Share of the full cost paid in cash
rows.explainer: With credit by share of resources, staff's forgone pay counts as part of the cost, and staff get their share of the outcome. Off, this is 100%.

rows.label: Welfare points per dollar you give
Share of the summary's welfare points a charity would deliver
rows.explainer: The summary's cost per welfare point counts equipment and running costs only. A charity also pays for staff and overhead, not every farmer takes up or keeps up aeration, and better oxygen can let farmers stock more densely, which FWI found and why it dropped aeration. We guess half the summary's welfare points survive this; 1 keeps the summary's figure. Our judgment; the range is ours.

rows.label: Days of disabling pain spared per dollar you give: fish
rows.explainer:
Unlike Ambitious Impact's later welfare points, this figure is not discounted for the chance fish are sentient (Vasco Grilo, EA Forum 2024: "the only cost-effectiveness analysis I know from AIM where the estimates in WPs were not adjusted for sentience"), so nothing is taken out before the bridge.

Each welfare-point-year is turned into days of disabling pain on the animal's own scale with the shared rate (facts: aim_wp.pain_days_per_wp_year), calibrated on Ambitious Impact's own welfare points and suffering-adjusted days for the same change. The rate and its range are ours, not Ambitious Impact's.

rows.label: Chicken-equivalent pain days averted per dollar you give: fish
rows.explainer: The days of pain of fish, weighed by how much they can suffer relative to a chicken (Rethink Priorities' estimates).

rows.label: Chicken-equivalent pain days averted per dollar you give
rows.explainer: Days of disabling pain spared, counted as a chicken's. The headline converts this into years of healthy life with the chicken slider and the healthy hours lost per day of disabling pain.

output.label: Chicken-equivalent pain days averted per dollar you give
